name: The Croaker
storyline: Jeremy was looking for food one day when he stumbled into an apple forest. Little did he know, this apple forest was owned by Virtual Guy, a man who had extremely good knowledge with technology. Jeremy ended up falling asleep, and was woken up by an apple falling on his head. Virtual Guy quickly took advantage of this and placed jeremy inside a simulation via a portal that sucked him in. Virtual Guy would use this simulation as revenge against him for eating nearly all of his apples. After running through 18 different simulations, jeremy was randomly faced with a level that had no finish flag: instead, it appears as if the level was never finished. He fell through this hole in the simulation, taking him to the outer layers, of the simulation, then a sewer system. Through the sewer system, he managed to find a pothole that led him right into the City. Now, a few miles away from the city was a massive volcano that was a few hours away from erupting, so he traversed through the city and met a man named Sir Croakington. Sir Croakington is an inventor and salesman, and he created this heat protection suit for Jeremy to use so that he could escape. He then found a vent for the volcano which would allow him to escape the city. He traversed the underground magma chamber of the volcano, then eventually made it all the way up the actual conduit and throat of the volcano. Finally, he used the massive explosion of lava to escape far away from virtual guy.
summary:
The Croaker is a very fun, feature-packed game where you can collect apples. Where's the fun in that? Well, these apples you collect are used all throughout the game: You can buy skins, powerups, unlock many achievements, and compete on leaderboards against the top players!

There are 50 campaign levels, where the protagonist, Jeremy, gets trapped in a simulation and must escape without the antagonist of Virtual Guy finding him. Not only that, there are going to be brand new Bonus Levels every few updates just to keep adding content to the game.
